rng.algorithm: numpy PCG64 (XSL-RR 128/64), SeedSequence-seeded; states are post-seeding

level_trim.note: matched to the shipped EDGE at velocity 0.9 (1 s RMS from the strike), then +2 dB (Kris: the hardest hits a dB or two louder); not re-measured

notes: bow_shoulder bow_vp in slots EDGE (a copy of BOW2), BOW2: every V5 column (2, 3, 4) replaced with V4 (column 0), vel_norms kept, so every velocity plays V4 and nothing up to velocity 0.9905 changes; presets/nova/data/nova_vel_participation_shoulder_correct.json is unchanged. Why: above velocity 0.9905 (MIDI 126-127) V5 made the bow shoulder bell-like: it has about half of V4's modes (531 against 1091 above 0.01), its ring at velocity 1.0 is dominated by 647 Hz and 2044 Hz, and it is 5.6 dB quieter than V4 at 0.98.

added_modes.note: edge-only modes inserted at their frequency (presets/nova/edge_v2/nova_edge_v2_modes.json); their seeded values are as baked, NOVA's own modes are checked against NOVA's streams; a strike's phases: NOVA's modes from the render stream as before, the added modes after them from a stream of their own

baked_picks.note: stereo picks baked, not seeded: modes the edge plays and bow and bell barely touch, with the picks of one of their band's strongest bow/bell modes, so the edge sits in the cymbal's stereo field (Kris, 2026-11-27); lfo_rate_hz / lfo_phase stay seeded

edge_v2.approved: Kris, 2026-11-27, by ear (docs/PORT_MAP.md, "NOVA RIDE edge v2")
